records.title: Oak National Academy — Read and write numbers with up to3 decimal places
records.read: Actual primaryHTML learning/keypoints/misconception/teacher tip and licence416–448, public quiz text corroborates multiple equivalent parts. No slides/video/PDF downloaded. One shared cluster search, not three separate searches.
records.adopted: Connect the same whole, decimal place chart and number words; teach zero placeholders and equivalent units, not reading by string length alone.
records.rejected: No English decimal point for Finnish display, compulsory speech, imported Year5 mandate, copied exercises or inferred learner efficacy.
records.licence: Inspected page states ©Oak2025 OGL3 except otherwise stated. No source prose/art/slides copied; original Finnish examples/diagrams/code.

records.title: NCETM1.24 — Composition and calculation: hundredths and thousandths
records.read: ActualHTML introduction and teachingpoints1–8 lines61–77. CopyrightHTML55–57 independently inspected at https://www.ncetm.org.uk/copyright/. Guide/representation downloads not opened.
records.adopted: Fixed-whole equal partitions and additive place-value composition; ten hundredths make a tenth and thousandths extend the same structure.
records.rejected: Column algorithms, rounding and timed mastery claims outside these three boundaries; no mandatory one-method response.
records.licence: NCETM default Crown/OGL subject to attribution and named-author/third-party exceptions. Conceptual comparison only; no protected figures/long text copied.

records.title: Kielitoimiston ohjepankki — Luvut ja numerot: desimaaliluvut
records.read: ActualHTML10–43 Finnish decimal notation/place labels and footer91–94. Linked licence opened: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0/deed.fi .
records.adopted: Finnish display uses comma; whole part and decimal part remain distinct. Digital point input is a permitted input accommodation, not the recommended Finnish display convention.
records.rejected: No fullsource reproduction, translation/adaptation of protected prose or claim that language guidance proves teaching effectiveness.
records.licence: ©Kotimaisten kielten keskus2026; linked CC BY-NC-ND4.0. No reproduction/derivative permission assumed. Only notation facts corroborated; lesson prose, examples and SVG are original.

inventory.hintsTransfer: Trailing digits as one count, placeholder0; sort names from1/2/3decimal places, reversefromWords recognition, euro/cent reading.

planning.teacherObjective: Harjoittelee lukemisen merkityksen muodostamista, kokonaisosa, osien määrä ja yksikkö; kolme kenttää eivät ole puheen tai koko lukuprosessin arvio.
planning.childGoal: Luen luvun niin, että osien koko säilyy.
planning.scope: Nonnegative0..9,999, exact integer thousandths. Display Finnishcomma. Rawplainnumberinput max128characters; normalized atmost3nonzero decimal places, harmless extra zeros accepted. No approximation, exponent, fraction expression or arbitrary natural language parser.
planning.sourceVsDesign: Frozen Finnish curriculum refs inherited, not freshly OPH-revalidated. Primary cluster teaching/language sources compared once2026-10-29. Sequence, controlled steps, examples, finite inputgrammar and checks project-authored, no efficacy claim.
planning.evidenceLimits: No formal rubric/personal mastery state. READ checked meaningfields not fulloral reading; WRITE typed production not fullprocess/dictation/handwriting validation. No audio, names, compulsory modelclicks or speed gate. Teacher/offline observation suggested, not performed.
